cases.name: Branch pins exact base, policy, fact and source without changing approved content
Viewer and scientific reviewer cannot author a branch
Cross-object branch target is rejected
Unsupported branch properties cannot inject scientific values
Editing retains immutable candidate history and exact source pins
A second author cannot edit the named proposal
Old branch digest fails even with current workspace revision
No-change proposals cannot consume a review approval
Unsupported numeric claims fail proposal QC before review
Author cannot self-approve submitted branch
Owner contributor cannot self-approve despite owner authority
Admin authoring role does not grant independent scientific review
Independent decision binds exact candidate digest
Review request and rejection block merge
New proposal revision invalidates independent branch approval
Reviewed merge creates a candidate and stales prior main approval
Merged contributor still cannot approve resulting scientific content
Fresh independent scientific approval is required after proposal merge
Changed base blocks approved proposal merge rather than overwriting
Source replacement blocks merge and marks branch stale on read
Changed governing policy blocks branch review
Abandon preserves history even when source is stale
Repeated merge is rejected and cannot duplicate a main revision
Rule branch cannot inject executable DSL or invented categories
Rule merge preserves predecessor and creates an unapproved source-cited revision
Branch inspection is pure and never silently mutates workspace

boundary: Synthetic engineering checks for isolated draft/rule proposals, independent exact-revision review, merge/staleness and fresh approval. No production acceptance or scientific validity claim.
